scripts.build: npm -w packages/contracts run build && npm -w apps/web run build
scripts.test: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tools -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -B tools/secret_guard.py && python3 -B tools/no_external_refs.py && python3 -B tools/ui_policy.py && python3 -B tools/ui_inventory.py --check && node tools/ui_templates.mjs && node tools/ui_catalog.mjs --check && npm -w packages/contracts run test && npm -w apps/web run test
